summary: Wrote a six-phase plan for the invocation-path-dependent repo-root resolution defect. Planning isolated each of the five named suites' root causes empirically: three need a plain swap to the existing common_test_repo_root helper, test-lint-deploy-caller-wrap.sh needs common_test_ext_root (its EXTENSIONS_DIR widens to the repo root from the deployed path, double-counting every genuine caller via its deploy-tree duplicate), and test-orchestrate-build-aux-dispatch.sh's single failure is SUT-side: orchestrate-build-aux-dispatch.sh's EXT_ROOT glob cannot match from .claude/scripts because * does not match a leading dot, a real deployed-mode production defect. Two adjacent same-class suites outside the task's named five were surfaced and absorbed as a measure-first sweep phase. One win and one scope-boundary issue were recorded as they arose.

artifacts.summary: Six phases in three waves, 5.75h: baseline both-path measurement, three helper migrations, the SUT-side EXT_ROOT fix, an adjacent-class sweep, then redeploy plus full-gate both-path confirmation and task-573 evidence.
